# idsec_pcloud_user (Data Source)

Privilege Cloud User data source, reads Vault user information based on the user ID.
<!-- BEGIN CUSTOM NOTES -->
<!-- END CUSTOM NOTES -->

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the Vault user to retrieve

### Read-Only

- `change_pass_on_next_logon` (Boolean) Whether the user must change password on next logon
- `enable_user` (Boolean) Whether the user account is enabled
- `location` (String) Vault location path for the user
- `password_never_expires` (Boolean) Whether the user's password never expires
- `user_type` (String) Vault user type (e.g. AppProvider)
- `username` (String) Vault username
